verdict.rationale: Saved templates are a fair question for an email-sending API, since comparable providers ship them, but the evidence never mentions saved snippets, reusable templates, or variable substitution. The documented Drafts feature is a human-review step for a single message, not a reusable template. Attachment support on ordinary outgoing messages is a separate capability and does not count as templating.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
